text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 20, 2023) for 27 Bergamot Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Having regard to the findings of fact made by the Superior Court of Ontario in judicial decisions in reference to this particular property and its handrails/guards, rescinded the Property Standards Order (July 20, 2023) for 27 Bergamot Avenue, Folder Number: 23 174908 PRS 00 IV.
